info.title: Clockgrove private conversations
info.description: Wave 5 RW-0501 local path. Every route needs `runtime:world-observe`; every route but `say` also needs the `conversation` privacy category and a resolved world persona. Contract: docs/protocols/conversations.md.

post.summary: Open a private session with an actor
post.description: The actor must be an actor (an entity with needs) projected in the request's space: otherwise `409 talk_unavailable` or `409 selection_unavailable`. `409 conversation_limit_reached` past 100 sessions that are not deleted per participant and world timeline. Optional channel/threadId binds a private thread to one session; explicit thread retries return that session. Browser defaults remain unchanged.

threadId.description: Opaque ID, at most 1024 UTF-8 octets; no leading or trailing whitespace.

post.description: Sessions of the world timeline that are not deleted, newest update first, optionally for one actor. Another member's sessions are never listed.

post.summary: Read a page of one session's history

post.description: Terminal: the session and its messages are no longer listed or readable and take no messages. Their ciphertext is retained until Wave 9 crypto-shred (db/retention.json).

Accepts the participant's message as a recoverable turn in the session actor's owner (`ActorAgentDO`) and answers when it commits: the message and the actor's answer (the scripted model fixture) are appended together. Never spatial speech. The message ID is the turn's key: a retry or duplicate delivery joins, resumes or returns the same turn and never adds a message; other text under it answers `409 message_id_reused`. `409 conversation_busy` while another turn of the session is open, `conversation_not_active`, `conversation_full` (1,000 messages), or `turn_cancelled`. With `Accept: application/x-ndjson` the answer streams `TalkStreamFrame` lines: disposable `delta` tokens, then one `receipt` or `refused` frame. `503 turn_interrupted` (or a stream without a final frame) means the owner failed mid-turn: resend the same message ID. Optional ingress metadata is checked against the verified session identity. Changed normalized metadata under an existing messageId is refused as message_id_reused; reply metadata must name a message in this session.

messageId.description: Must not end with ":reply": the answer to message x is stored as x:reply.

text.description: At most 1024 UTF-8 octets, not blank.

post.description: The addressed actor speaks a fixed scripted line aloud, attributed to the caller. Needs no `conversation` category and is never stored in a session.

text.description: At most 1024 UTF-8 octets, not blank.

post.description: What a reconnecting client reads instead of streamed tokens. Reading it also lets the actor's owner resume the participant's open turns.
Cancels a turn that has not started committing: it commits no message and its run ends `cancelled`. A turn already committing or finished answers its status unchanged.

participants.description: The session's human participants (principal and world persona), ordered by principal ID; each principal and persona at most once. A Caretaker Talk session has exactly one.

threadId.description: Opaque ID, at most 1024 UTF-8 octets; no leading or trailing whitespace.

TalkStreamFrame.description: One NDJSON line of a streamed Talk.

attempt.description: Owner claims so far; each opened one run.
